planets.name: Kepler-138 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-138 with a 23.1-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-138 d was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-138. Its orbit and size follow Piaulet et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
